units.source_text: 然而，谁都没有理由认为，那洞穴里的生活和这风景是互相对立的。

en.t: Yet no one had any reason to think that life in that pit and this landscape were opposed to each other.

units.source_text: 美丽的风景，任何地方都没有宽容人的必要。

en.t: A beautiful landscape, wherever it may be, has no need to be forgiving toward people.

units.source_text: 结果，认为沙子拒绝固定，是我的出发点，这可没有错乱的念头。

en.t: In the end, my starting point was the idea that sand rejects being fixed in place, and there was nothing deranged about that thought.

units.source_text: 1/8mm的流动……状态原封不动存在的世界……这种美简直是属于死之领土的东西。

en.t: A movement of 1/8 mm... a world where a state exists exactly as it is... this kind of beauty belongs almost entirely to the territory of death.

units.source_text: 通过巨大破坏力和废墟的庄严所反映的，死之壮美。

en.t: The sublime beauty of death, reflected through enormous destructive power and the solemn grandeur of ruins.

units.source_text: 但对于捏着往返车票不肯放手的议论是没有立足点的。

en.t: But an argument that refuses to let go of a return ticket has no ground to stand on.

units.source_text: 猛兽电影、战争电影的乐趣在于，打开门等待我们的是继续昨天的“今天”，

en.t: The pleasure of films about wild beasts or war lies in the fact that when we open the door, what waits for us is a today that continues from yesterday,

units.source_text: 哪怕逼真到令人心脏病发作的地步……难道会有荷枪实弹前往电影院的傻瓜吗……

en.t: even if it is realistic enough to give us a heart attack... would any fool go to the movie theater carrying a loaded gun...

units.source_text: 沙漠之中，由风景来调和生活的，充其量，是一些只知单程车票的游牧民，

en.t: In the desert, those whose lives are reconciled by the landscape are, at most, nomads who know only one-way tickets,

units.source_text: 喝自己小便代替喝水的特种老鼠，以腐肉为饵食的昆虫等等。

en.t: special kinds of mice that drink their own urine instead of water, insects that feed on carrion, and the like.

units.source_text: 如果它们顽固认为，车票本来就只有单程的，那么，

en.t: If they stubbornly believe that tickets are only one-way to begin with, then

units.source_text: 它们就不会徒劳地试着模仿贴在岩石上的牡蛎那样，往沙子上贴。

en.t: they will not futilely try to imitate oysters clinging to rocks by clinging to the sand.

units.source_text: 不过，这些游牧方式如今连称呼也改为畜产业了……

en.t: Still, these nomadic ways have now had even their name changed to livestock farming...
